notes: These entries describe 25 reusable static sprite slots, not the current database resident roster.
The legacy images are not visual references. Only the text specifications below may be sent to the image provider.
sprite_key remains stable because player templates, NPC fallback paths, onboarding, and landing portraits consume it.

slots.appearance: Middle-aged man with warm brown skin, close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair, round glasses, a teal knit vest over a white shirt, charcoal trousers, and oxford shoes. Carry a small graph-paper notebook; use a compact, thoughtful silhouette.

Adult man with olive skin, wavy dark hair tied loosely at the nape, a mustard scarf, forest-green long coat, dark jeans, and worn leather boots. His posture is calm and reflective, with one small pocket book as an accessory.

Broad-shouldered adult man with fair skin, ginger hair and a tidy beard, rolled cream sleeves, a burgundy waistcoat, dark apron, navy trousers, and sturdy boots. Friendly open stance; include a small brass bottle opener at the belt.

Adult woman with medium-brown skin and dark curls in a high bun, wearing a coral headband, pale blue blouse, deep green cafe apron, cropped black trousers, and red flats. Bright welcoming posture with a tiny enamel coffee pin.

Young man with light-brown skin, short sandy hair, a cobalt university jacket with one orange patch, gray T-shirt, black cargo trousers, and white sneakers. Slender energetic build; carry a folded community flyer.

Adult man with tan skin, shoulder-length black hair, narrow mustache, plum shirt under a cropped black jacket, cream trousers, and dark ankle boots. Expressive angular stance; a red pocket notebook provides the single bright accent.

Adult woman with golden-brown skin, a short black bob, amber glasses, rust-orange utility jacket over a navy shirt, khaki trousers, and brown work shoes. Practical square silhouette with a small key ring clipped at the waist.

Young Black woman with a close natural afro, red square glasses, cream field jacket over a cobalt top, black trousers, and sturdy red sneakers. Alert balanced stance; a compact camera hangs from a short strap at chest level.

Adult woman with freckled fair skin and copper curls cut to the shoulders, oversized navy cardigan, striped green top, rust trousers, and blue ankle boots. Curious animated posture with a tiny fountain pen clipped to one pocket.

Young woman with light olive skin, long dark hair in a side braid, violet headphones resting around her neck, white science-club hoodie, teal skirt over leggings, and purple sneakers. Bright energetic silhouette with a small star pin.

Middle-aged woman with fair skin, soft brown hair in a practical bun, sky-blue cardigan, patterned red neck scarf, charcoal midi skirt, and comfortable tan shoes. Organized approachable stance with a small ring of household keys.
